places.name: Tiger's Leap (Tigai Point)
places.description: Maharashtra's most dramatic valley viewpoint, at its most spectacular during monsoon.
places.bestTime: June to September for cloud-filled valleys; early morning for clearest air

places.name: Bhushi Dam
places.description: The most joyful monsoon waterplay spot in the Mumbai-Pune hill belt.
places.bestTime: July to September when the spillway overflows dramatically

places.name: Lohagad Fort
places.description: A full-fledged hill-fort experience within two hours of Mumbai or Pune.
places.bestTime: October to February for clear views; monsoon for dramatic mist and greenery

places.name: Karla Caves
places.description: The finest early Buddhist chaitya hall in India, largely intact after two millennia.
places.bestTime: October to March; morning visit before crowds arrive

places.name: Bhaja Caves
places.description: Quieter and arguably more atmospheric than Karla, with remarkable early relief sculptures.
places.bestTime: July to September for the waterfall; October to February for crowd-free exploration

places.name: Pawna Lake
places.description: The most scenic camping spot in the Pune-Mumbai region with a fort-ringed horizon.
places.bestTime: October to February for clear skies; post-monsoon (September–October) for full lake and green hills

places.name: Visapur Fort
places.description: A vast, wild fort plateau rarely crowded despite being Maharashtra's most extensive hilltop ruin.
places.bestTime: October to January for clear panoramic views

places.name: Lonavala Lake
places.description: A quiet, reflective morning escape just minutes from the busy Lonavala market.
places.bestTime: July to October when the lake is full and mist hangs over the water

places.name: Rajmachi Fort
places.description: One of Maharashtra's most rewarding overnight trekking destinations with wild, unspoiled surroundings.
places.bestTime: October to February for the clearest trail conditions and views

places.name: Tikona Fort (Vitandgad)
places.description: The most dramatically shaped peak near Lonavala, with Pawna Lake glittering below.
places.bestTime: October to February for clear skies; July–September for a green, misty ascent

budget.label: Budget
budget.blurb: Hostels or guesthouses, local food, public transport

midRange.label: Mid-range
midRange.blurb: Three-star hotels, a mix of restaurants, the odd taxi

comfortable.label: Comfortable
comfortable.blurb: Good four-star stays, restaurants by choice, tours
